chunks: Zurara narrated from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
I said to him, 'Is there anything [regarding] the buffaloes?' He said: 'Similar to what is [regarding] the cows.'

key_terms.الْجَوَامِيسِ: Buffaloes (plural of jawm), specifically referring to water buffaloes used in agriculture
key_terms.زُرَارَةُ: Zurara ibn A'yan, a prominent companion of the Imams

ai.seo_question: What is the zakat ruling for buffaloes in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Zurara queries Imam al-Baqir regarding the specific zakat ruling for 'al-jawamis' (buffaloes), to which the Imam responds that their status is identical to that of cows. This hadith establishes a key principle of juristic analogy (qiyas) in Shia fiqh, demonstrating how the detailed zakat tables of the Quran are extended to similar livestock based on functional and physical equivalence. It highlights the practical flexibility of the Imams in applying fixed scriptural rulings to evolving agricultural contexts.

en.hubeali:
Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘is there anything upon the buffaloes?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Similar to what is regarding the cows’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from Zurarah who has said the following: “I once asked abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
about buffalos if there is Zakat for it. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is like cows.’”
